fact: Term 'Cradle of Coaches' was popularized by Bob Kurz, a 1958 Miami graduate and former Miami Sports Information Director, in his book 'Miami of Ohio: The Cradle of Coaches'
Kurz's inspiration came in 1959, when Miami alumni Paul Dietzel and Ara Parseghian led the top two college programs while Paul Brown, Sid Gillman and Weeb Ewbank were changing the pro game
Cradle of Coaches Plaza established in 2009; bronze statues at the south gate of Yager Stadium
